planets.name: TOI-5489 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5489 with a 4.92-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-5489 c was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-5489. Its orbit and size follow Gomez Barrientos et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
